measurement_semantics.top_weak_normal_reactions: Minus prescribed-top weak nodal internal residual, in N; not a verified unilateral contact multiplier or pressure.
measurement_semantics.minimum_weak_normal_reaction: Minimum of top_weak_normal_reactions, retaining its signed value.
measurement_semantics.normal_force: Sum of signed prescribed-top weak reactions, including material and regularization contributions; not a direct material-edge traction integral.

prefix_semantics: A solve that fails or times out keeps every persisted accepted state and its log. Only a contiguous run of states that pass the independent audit is called a verified comparable prefix; unaudited, incomplete or unfinished parts do not count. The frozen audit requires a complete controller/completion inventory, so a hard timeout that leaves only per-state files is not certified; no resume, rescue solve or incomplete-directory audit is added. The 21 accepted states of the v3 run are a historical observation, not a v4 requirement: the 7 original targets and the control rules are.

summary.scope: v4 kernel-repair re-test of the single fine-mesh uniform path; node reactions are not verified contact pressures
